name: Cyamemazine
summary: Cyamemazine (Tercian), also known as cyamepromazine, is a typical antipsychotic drug of the phenothiazine class which was introduced by Theraplix in France in 1972 and later in Portugal as well.

pharmacology.text: Cyamemazine differs from other phenothiazine neuroleptics in that aside from the usual profile of dopamine, α1-adrenergic, H1, and mACh receptor antagonism, it additionally produces potent blockade of several serotonin receptors, including 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C, and 5-HT7.

uses.text: It is used for the treatment of schizophrenia and, especially, for psychosis-associated anxiety, due to its unique anxiolytic efficacy. It is also used to reduce anxiety associated with benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome and anxiety in depression with suicidal tendency.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness on standing, dry mouth, constipation and weight gain. Like other phenothiazines it can cause movement problems such as stiffness and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、起身時頭暈、口乾、便秘與體重增加。和其他啡噻𠯤類一樣，它可能造成僵硬、坐立不安等動作問題，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、起身时头晕、口干、便秘与体重增加。和其他啡噻𠯤类一样，它可能造成僵硬、坐立不安等动作问题，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: The RP in its old code name stands for Rhône-Poulenc, the French company where chlorpromazine was made. Cyamemazine carries a cyano group where chlorpromazine has a chlorine atom.
fact.zh: 它舊代號中的 RP 代表法國羅納普朗克公司，也就是氯丙嗪誕生的地方。Cyamemazine 在氯丙嗪帶氯原子的位置換成了氰基。
fact.zhHans: 它旧代号中的 RP 代表法国罗纳普朗克公司，也就是氯丙嗪诞生的地方。Cyamemazine 在氯丙嗪带氯原子的位置换成了氰基。
